changes: lattice.config.json: one bare-string entry "node packages/main/dist/tasks/reviewer-scan-budget-guard-smoke.js" added to validate.commands, directly after the retired-authority-vocabulary-guard-smoke.js entry (line 28). usage: Run: lattice validate — the guard executes as one of the configured commands and fails validate if reviewer prompt copies regress to unconditional full decisions-directory scans or lose required bounded-search phrases. Fast lane (lattice validate --focus=fast) intentionally skips it (entry has no focus tag).
expectedOutcome: Full lattice validate output lists node packages/main/dist/tasks/reviewer-scan-budget-guard-smoke.js as an executed command printing "reviewer-scan-budget-guard: PASS (6 prompt copies clean, 4 required phrases present)" and validate exits 0 overall.

outcomeDiff: No difference: expected and actual match exactly (guard executed in full validate with PASS and overall exit 0; skipped in fast lane).
limitations: none — fully covered. Note (by design, not a defect): the guard runs only in full validate, not in --focus=fast, matching every other bare-string guard entry; and if a guarded prompt file is ever deleted the guard fails with a raw ENOENT crash (non-zero exit still blocks validate; same behavior as sibling guard smokes).
pitfalls: Three items worth knowing: (1) hard dependency sequencing — the wiring had to wait for B-cee5 DONE-merge (7cda28285); wiring earlier would have broken every validate on main because packages/main/dist is untracked and the referenced file could not be built from main. (2) The shared scope classifier fails closed on newer ProofStory metadata (intent-collision.json, original-intent-snapshot.json, proofstory.json); cleared with one scope_contract_acknowledge naming those command-generated artifacts. (3) The story_review PLAN gate mechanically requires all three verificationIntent lanes non-empty per item — an honest empty edge lane for a validate-run item still blocks; add a meaningful fast-lane-skip edge intent instead of padding. No retries were burned beyond those; validate stayed green throughout.
